observations.body: A light, a voice, and Ananias meet Saul. But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

payload.posture: Read Acts 9:1–18 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a light, a voice, and Ananias meet Saul. But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
